{{Top|leg}}
'''Bioelectricity''' was a unique feature of [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] biology. It allowed Parwans to produce intense electrical fields, which caused them to crackle with energy. Some aggressive members of this [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], could use their biology as a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] in the form of bio-electric shocks.<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>

The [[bio-cocoon]] manufactured by [[Dendratis Biological Exports, Incorporated]] was coated with a layer of dormant microorganisms, that fed off bio-electricity. When a creature stood on one of the fibers, a remote control would trigger other organisms that activated the microorganisms. They fed off the target's bio-electricity, swarming over the creature and creating a porous biological cocoon.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
